lines.text: Something is dying, and you did not ask it to.
lines.spoken: Something is dying, and you did not ask it to.

lines.text: Not a person, necessarily. A thing you were good at.
lines.spoken: Not a person, necessarily. A thing you were good at.

lines.text: A room you used to walk into and feel at home in.
lines.spoken: A room you used to walk into and feel at home in.

lines.text: A way of praying that used to feel like a conversation, and now feels like talking to a ceiling.
lines.spoken: A way of praying that used to feel like a conversation, and now feels like talking to a ceiling.

lines.text: And here is the part that keeps you up. Nothing obviously went wrong.
lines.spoken: And here is the part that keeps you up. Nothing obviously went wrong.

lines.text: You did not sin your way here. You did not get lazy.
lines.spoken: You did not sin your way here. You did not get lazy.

lines.text: You were faithful. And the leaves still came off.
lines.spoken: You were faithful. And the leaves still came off.

lines.text: So you have been doing the only thing you know to do. Apologising.
lines.spoken: So you have been doing the only thing you know to do. Apologising.

lines.text: Repenting of things you did not do. Confessing a dryness you cannot trace to any disobedience.
lines.spoken: Repenting of things you did not do. Confessing a dryness you cannot trace to any disobedience.

lines.text: That is the wrong question. And a lot of people are asking it this week.
lines.spoken: That is the wrong question. And a lot of people are asking it this week.

lines.text: Here is a trap that catches sincere Christians more than any other.
lines.spoken: Here is a trap that catches sincere Christians more than any other.

lines.text: We assume that anything God cuts, He cuts in anger.
lines.spoken: We assume that anything God cuts, He cuts in anger.

lines.text: It is a reasonable assumption, if your only image of God is a judge.
lines.spoken: It is a reasonable assumption, if your only image of God is a judge.

lines.text: A judge cuts to punish. So when the branch comes off, we go looking for the crime.
lines.spoken: A judge cuts to punish. So when the branch comes off, we go looking for the crime.

lines.text: And that misdiagnosis is expensive. It produces three things, every time.
lines.spoken: And that misdiagnosis is expensive. It produces three things, every time.

lines.text: One. False repentance. You confess sin you have not committed.
lines.spoken: One. False repentance. You confess sin you have not committed.

lines.text: Which trains you to distrust God's own voice.
lines.spoken: Which trains you to distrust God's own voice.

lines.text: Two. Despair. After enough dry weeks you conclude He has set you aside.
lines.spoken: Two. Despair. After enough dry weeks you conclude He has set you aside.

lines.text: Three. Self-protection. You stop planting anything new, because you assume it will be cut too.
lines.spoken: Three. Self-protection. You stop planting anything new, because you assume it will be cut too.

lines.text: But scripture gives us a completely different picture of why God cuts.
lines.spoken: But scripture gives us a completely different picture of why God cuts.

lines.text: It is not a courtroom. It is a vineyard.
lines.spoken: It is not a courtroom. It is a vineyard.

lines.text: God prunes where He intends to produce.
lines.spoken: God prunes where He intends to produce.

lines.text: Jesus says it in one verse that most of us have read too fast.
lines.spoken: Jesus says it in one verse that most of us have read too fast.

lines.text: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit, he takes away.
lines.spoken: Every branch in me that does not bear fruit, he takes away.

lines.text: Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
lines.spoken: Every branch that bears fruit, he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.

lines.text: Look carefully at who gets pruned. Not the barren branch. The fruitful one.
lines.spoken: Look carefully at who gets pruned. Not the barren branch. The fruitful one.

lines.text: The barren branch is taken away. The fruitful branch is pruned.
lines.spoken: The barren branch is taken away. The fruitful branch is pruned.

lines.text: And pruning is not removal. It is reduction with an intent.
lines.spoken: And pruning is not removal. It is reduction with an intent.

lines.text: So the question is not what did I do wrong. It is what am I being made ready to carry.
lines.spoken: So the question is not what did I do wrong. It is what am I being made ready to carry.
lines.typed: WHAT AM I BEING MADE READY TO CARRY?

lines.text: There are five marks of pruning that separate it from punishment.
lines.spoken: There are five marks of pruning that separate it from punishment.

lines.text: Sign one. What leaves is green.
lines.spoken: Sign one. What leaves is green.

lines.text: Punishment targets what is already dead.
lines.spoken: Punishment targets what is already dead.

lines.text: Pruning targets what is alive and healthy.
lines.spoken: Pruning targets what is alive and healthy.

lines.text: Which is why pruning always feels like a loss, and never feels like justice.
lines.spoken: Which is why pruning always feels like a loss, and never feels like justice.

lines.text: It does not feel fair, because it is not about fairness. It is about fruit.
lines.spoken: It does not feel fair, because it is not about fairness. It is about fruit.

lines.text: Think about what came off in the last year. It was working.
lines.spoken: Think about what came off in the last year. It was working.

lines.text: You were the one people called. And it did not fail. It was lifted.
lines.spoken: You were the one people called. And it did not fail. It was lifted.

lines.text: Moses is the model here.
lines.spoken: Moses is the model here.

lines.text: He refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.
lines.spoken: He refused to be called the son of Pharaoh's daughter.

lines.text: Choosing mistreatment with God's people over the pleasures of sin.
lines.spoken: Choosing mistreatment with God's people over the pleasures of sin.

lines.text: Notice what did not change. The palace stayed standing. The food did not get worse.
lines.spoken: Notice what did not change. The palace stayed standing. The food did not get worse.

lines.text: What changed was Moses. His spirit had outgrown the container of Egypt.
lines.spoken: What changed was Moses. His spirit had outgrown the container of Egypt.

lines.text: Sometimes the pruning is a place you are still good at.
lines.spoken: Sometimes the pruning is a place you are still good at.

lines.text: God is not revoking it. He is asking whether you will still be carrying it next season.
lines.spoken: God is not revoking it. He is asking whether you will still be carrying it next season.

lines.text: Sign two. It is quiet.
lines.spoken: Sign two. It is quiet.

lines.text: Punishment is loud. It has an indictment, a sentence, and a date.
lines.spoken: Punishment is loud. It has an indictment, a sentence, and a date.

lines.text: Pruning is quiet. Nothing is explained. No charge, no verdict, no closure.
lines.spoken: Pruning is quiet. Nothing is explained. No charge, no verdict, no closure.

lines.text: It is a gardener with a knife and no commentary.
lines.spoken: It is a gardener with a knife and no commentary.

lines.text: You are praying and getting nothing back. Not a rebuke. Nothing.
lines.spoken: You are praying and getting nothing back. Not a rebuke. Nothing.

lines.text: Consider Joseph. Two vivid dreams at seventeen, then a pit, then a sale, then an accusation.
lines.spoken: Consider Joseph. Two vivid dreams at seventeen, then a pit, then a sale, then an accusation.

lines.text: Scripture records no word from God to Joseph for thirteen years.
lines.spoken: Scripture records no word from God to Joseph for thirteen years.

lines.text: No voice. No angel. No verse.
lines.spoken: No voice. No angel. No verse.

lines.text: And yet the writer of Genesis says the thing that undoes the whole silence.
lines.spoken: And yet the writer of Genesis says the thing that undoes the whole silence.

lines.text: You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.
lines.spoken: You meant evil against me, but God meant it for good.

lines.text: To bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.
lines.spoken: To bring to pass, as it is today, to save many people alive.

lines.text: God was not absent in the silence. He was working in a medium the silence concealed.
lines.spoken: God was not absent in the silence. He was working in a medium the silence concealed.

lines.text: His silence is not His absence. Sometimes it is the sound of Him working on something He has not shown you yet.
lines.spoken: His silence is not His absence. Sometimes it is the sound of Him working on something He has not shown you yet.

lines.text: The vision is yet for the appointed time. Though it takes time, wait for it.
lines.spoken: The vision is yet for the appointed time. Though it takes time, wait for it.

lines.text: It will surely come. It will not delay.
lines.spoken: It will surely come. It will not delay.

lines.text: Sign three. You are being reduced, not corrected.
lines.spoken: Sign three. You are being reduced, not corrected.

lines.text: A gardener does not take off branches to punish the tree.
lines.spoken: A gardener does not take off branches to punish the tree.

lines.text: He takes off what spends the tree's strength without returning fruit.
lines.spoken: He takes off what spends the tree's strength without returning fruit.

lines.text: The tree ends up smaller and stronger. Not corrected and resentful.
lines.spoken: The tree ends up smaller and stronger. Not corrected and resentful.

lines.text: Your options are narrowing. Doors that used to open are not opening.
lines.spoken: Your options are narrowing. Doors that used to open are not opening.

lines.text: Your calendar is emptying. And your flesh reads that as decline.
lines.spoken: Your calendar is emptying. And your flesh reads that as decline.

lines.text: Look at what God did to Israel's army before He gave them a victory.
lines.spoken: Look at what God did to Israel's army before He gave them a victory.

lines.text: Gideon gathers thirty two thousand men. God sends most of them home.
lines.spoken: Gideon gathers thirty two thousand men. God sends most of them home.

lines.text: Down to three hundred.
lines.spoken: Down to three hundred.

lines.text: And the reason is stated plainly. The people are too many for me.
lines.spoken: And the reason is stated plainly. The people are too many for me.

lines.text: Lest Israel brag, saying, my own hand has saved me.
lines.spoken: Lest Israel brag, saying, my own hand has saved me.

lines.text: The reduction was the preparation.
lines.spoken: The reduction was the preparation.

lines.text: God did not shrink the army because they were weak. He shrank it because they were strong enough to take the credit.
lines.spoken: God did not shrink the army because they were weak. He shrank it because they were strong enough to take the credit.

lines.text: God will reduce your resources before He increases your assignment.
lines.spoken: God will reduce your resources before He increases your assignment.

lines.text: Because an assignment that does not need Him is not an assignment He can bless.
lines.spoken: Because an assignment that does not need Him is not an assignment He can bless.

lines.text: If your capacity is shrinking and your dependence is growing, you are not being demoted. You are being fitted.
lines.spoken: If your capacity is shrinking and your dependence is growing, you are not being demoted. You are being fitted.

lines.text: Sign four. The old tools go blunt.
lines.spoken: Sign four. The old tools go blunt.

lines.text: The methods that used to work stop working.
lines.spoken: The methods that used to work stop working.

lines.text: This is the one that terrifies competent people.
lines.spoken: This is the one that terrifies competent people.

lines.text: You have a way of doing this. Your approach. Your instincts.
lines.spoken: You have a way of doing this. Your approach. Your instincts.

lines.text: And one day they simply do not return results.
lines.spoken: And one day they simply do not return results.

lines.text: The strategy that used to close. The argument that used to land. The routine that used to fill you.
lines.spoken: The strategy that used to close. The argument that used to land. The routine that used to fill you.

lines.text: You are working harder and getting less. You assume you have lost your edge.
lines.spoken: You are working harder and getting less. You assume you have lost your edge.

lines.text: Peter, a professional fisherman, fishes all night on his own expertise and catches nothing.
lines.spoken: Peter, a professional fisherman, fishes all night on his own expertise and catches nothing.

lines.text: Master, we worked all night, and took nothing.
lines.spoken: Master, we worked all night, and took nothing.

lines.text: But at your word I will let down the net.
lines.spoken: But at your word I will let down the net.

lines.text: An expert failed at his own trade. Not because he forgot how to fish.
lines.spoken: An expert failed at his own trade. Not because he forgot how to fish.

lines.text: Because his competence had become his confidence.
lines.spoken: Because his competence had become his confidence.

lines.text: And Jesus needed the net to come up full only after the word came first.
lines.spoken: And Jesus needed the net to come up full only after the word came first.

lines.text: When your competence stops working, God is not retiring you.
lines.spoken: When your competence stops working, God is not retiring you.

lines.text: He is relocating your confidence. From your hands to His word.
lines.spoken: He is relocating your confidence. From your hands to His word.

lines.text: The blunt tools are a mercy. They are the only thing that will get a capable person to ask for help.
lines.spoken: The blunt tools are a mercy. They are the only thing that will get a capable person to ask for help.

lines.text: Sign five. There is fruit you did not plant.
lines.spoken: Sign five. There is fruit you did not plant.

lines.text: After pruning, you find growth you never sowed.
lines.spoken: After pruning, you find growth you never sowed.

lines.text: Not the growth you were working for. Not the old branch returning.
lines.spoken: Not the growth you were working for. Not the old branch returning.

lines.text: Something else. A patience you did not have.
lines.spoken: Something else. A patience you did not have.

lines.text: A hunger for scripture you did not manufacture.
lines.spoken: A hunger for scripture you did not manufacture.

lines.text: A capacity to sit with people in pain that you could not have trained.
lines.spoken: A capacity to sit with people in pain that you could not have trained.

lines.text: And it embarrasses you a little, because you did not do the work for it.
lines.spoken: And it embarrasses you a little, because you did not do the work for it.

lines.text: Those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength.
lines.spoken: Those who wait for Yahweh will renew their strength.

lines.text: They will mount up with wings like eagles.
lines.spoken: They will mount up with wings like eagles.

lines.text: They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.
lines.spoken: They will run, and not be weary. They will walk, and not faint.

lines.text: Notice the order. Wait first, then wings.
lines.spoken: Notice the order. Wait first, then wings.

lines.text: The strength is renewed. It is not the old strength restored. It is a different strength issued.
lines.spoken: The strength is renewed. It is not the old strength restored. It is a different strength issued.

lines.text: The proof of your faith is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire.
lines.spoken: The proof of your faith is more precious than gold that perishes, even though it is tested by fire.

lines.text: Gold is not tested because it is suspected. It is tested because it is valuable.
lines.spoken: Gold is not tested because it is suspected. It is tested because it is valuable.

lines.text: The fruit of pruning is never the branch you lost. It is a root you did not know you had.
lines.spoken: The fruit of pruning is never the branch you lost. It is a root you did not know you had.
lines.hero: card A ROOT YOU DID NOT KNOW

lines.text: So what do you actually do, this week, if you suspect you are being pruned.
lines.spoken: So what do you actually do, this week, if you suspect you are being pruned.

lines.text: One. Stop repenting of things you did not do.
lines.spoken: One. Stop repenting of things you did not do.

lines.text: False repentance is not humility. It is a way of making the silence your fault so you can control it.
lines.spoken: False repentance is not humility. It is a way of making the silence your fault so you can control it.

lines.text: If the Spirit is convicting you, He will be specific.
lines.spoken: If the Spirit is convicting you, He will be specific.

lines.text: Two. Ask a different question.
lines.spoken: Two. Ask a different question.

lines.text: Not what did I do wrong. But what am I being made ready to carry.
lines.spoken: Not what did I do wrong. But what am I being made ready to carry.
lines.typed: WHAT AM I BEING MADE READY TO CARRY?

lines.text: The second question has an answer. The first one, in a pruning season, does not.
lines.spoken: The second question has an answer. The first one, in a pruning season, does not.

lines.text: Three. Be still long enough to find out.
lines.spoken: Three. Be still long enough to find out.

lines.text: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.
lines.spoken: Yahweh will fight for you, and you shall be still.

lines.text: Be still, and know that I am God.
lines.spoken: Be still, and know that I am God.

lines.text: Stillness is not passivity. It is the posture of someone who has stopped forcing the door.
lines.spoken: Stillness is not passivity. It is the posture of someone who has stopped forcing the door.

lines.text: Four. Guard the peace that does not match your circumstances.
lines.spoken: Four. Guard the peace that does not match your circumstances.

lines.text: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts.
lines.spoken: And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts.

lines.text: If you have a calm about this that you cannot explain and did not produce, do not talk yourself out of it.
lines.spoken: If you have a calm about this that you cannot explain and did not produce, do not talk yourself out of it.
lines.hero: card DO NOT TALK YOURSELF OUT OF IT

lines.text: That peace is evidence. It is the Gardener's hand on the frame.
lines.spoken: That peace is evidence. It is the Gardener's hand on the frame.

lines.text: Five. Let the lament be real.
lines.spoken: Five. Let the lament be real.

lines.text: Pruning hurts. It is allowed to hurt.
lines.spoken: Pruning hurts. It is allowed to hurt.
lines.hero: card IT IS ALLOWED TO HURT

lines.text: You do not have to pretend the branch did not matter.
lines.spoken: You do not have to pretend the branch did not matter.

lines.text: Isaiah gives us the promise that makes all of this bearable.
lines.spoken: Isaiah gives us the promise that makes all of this bearable.

lines.text: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Do you not know it?
lines.spoken: Behold, I will do a new thing. It springs out now. Do you not know it?

lines.text: I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.
lines.spoken: I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

lines.text: It springs out now. Not after you have earned it.
lines.spoken: It springs out now. Not after you have earned it.

lines.text: Not after you have worked out what you did wrong.
lines.spoken: Not after you have worked out what you did wrong.

lines.text: Now. In the middle of the quiet. In the middle of the reduced version of your life.
lines.spoken: Now. In the middle of the quiet. In the middle of the reduced version of your life.

lines.text: While the wound is still fresh.
lines.spoken: While the wound is still fresh.

lines.text: You are not being punished. You are being prepared.
lines.spoken: You are not being punished. You are being prepared.

lines.text: If this gave you language for something you have been carrying,
lines.spoken: If this gave you language for something you have been carrying,

lines.text: share it with the person who keeps asking God what they did wrong.
lines.spoken: share it with the person who keeps asking God what they did wrong.
lines.hero: card THE PERSON WHO KEEPS ASKING
lines.typed: KEEPS ASKING WHAT THEY DID WRONG

lines.text: Somebody in your life is in a pruning season and thinks it is a verdict.
lines.spoken: Somebody in your life is in a pruning season and thinks it is a verdict.

lines.text: Stay rooted. He is not done with you.
lines.spoken: Stay rooted. He is not done with you.
